title: German translation of the owner UI
body:
Several owners asked for a German UI.

- Extract all user-visible strings of the web app into message catalogs (next-intl), English stays the default.
- Add a complete German catalog; dates and numbers use the de-DE locale.
- The language follows the Accept-Language header and can be overridden in the settings page.
- CI fails when a key exists in English but not in German.

repos.name: SigmaUno/subspace-web
repos.description: Next.js app; components under components/, settings page under app/settings

requirements.title: Extract user-visible strings into next-intl message catalogs
Add the German catalog with de-DE dates and numbers
Select the language from Accept-Language with a settings override
Fail CI when a German key is missing
